transactionId.description: The transaction ID of the recovery session.

accountId.description: The ID of the account that the device belongs to.

state.description: The state of the recovery operation.

created.description:
The timestamp when the recovery session was created.

Returned in pattern `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

operationProperties.description: An object that describes the properties used to carry out the operation.

riskAttributes.description: The risk attributes collected for the device. See [risk attributes](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Risk-attributes) for possible values. You can find out how to configure which attributes are collected in the application configuration feature documentation.

location.description: An object that describes the location of the device used for the operation. In order to be returned in the response, it has to be enabled in the application configuration.

attestation.description: An object that describes the properties of the attestation. In order for this object to be returned in response, it has to be enabled in the application configuration.

recoveryMethod.description:
The recovery method used for the recovery.

See [recovery methods](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Recovery-methods) for possible values.

recoveryStatus.description:
The status of the recovery.

See [recovery statuses](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Recovery-statuses) for possible values.

recoveryMethod.description:
The recovery method used for the recovery. 

 See [recovery methods](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Recovery-methods) for possible values.

recoveryStatus.description:
The status of the recovery. 

 See [recovery statuses](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Recovery-statuses) for possible values.

created.description: The timestamp when the recovery was created. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

modified.description: The timestamp when the recovery was updated. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

recovered.description: The timestamp when the recovery was used. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

AppAttestation.description: An object that describes the properties of the attestation. In order for this object to be returned in response, it has to be enabled in the application configuration.

playIntegrityStatus.description:
The Play Integrity attestation status for the user's device. 

 See [Play Integrity statuses](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Play-Integrity-statuses) for possible values.

playIntegrityDate.description: The date when the Play Integrity attestation was performed on the user's device.

appAttestStatus.description:
The App Attest attestation status for the user's device. 

 See [App Attest statuses](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/App-Attest-statuses) for possible values.

appAttestDate.description: The date when the App Attest attestation was performed on the user's device.

externalRef.description: An identifier generated by you (the customer), that points to the user ID (userId) generated by MobileID when a new user is created.

segment.description: A parameter used for segmentation of end-users and their corresponding transactions.

id.description: The ID of the user (userId), in a valid UUID format.

created.description: The timestamp when the user was created. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

lastUsed.description: The timestamp when the user last executed any REGISTRATION, AUTHENTICATION or SIGNATURE operation. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

state.description: The state of the user. This is returned as an enum, and can be either ACTIVE or LOCKED.

id.description: The ID of the user's device (deviceId).

name.description: The name of the user's device.

state.description: The state of the user's device. This is returned as an enum, and can be either ACTIVE, LOCKED or DELETED.

lastOperationType.description:
The last operation type that the user's device executed. 

 See [operation type](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Operation-types) for possible values.

lastUsed.description: The timestamp when the user's device last executed an operation. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

created.description: The timestamp when the user's device was originally activated. Returned in pattern yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ.

lock.description:
An object that contains details about the device lock. 

 This object is only supplied when the user's device is locked.

activationTime.description: The timestamp when the user's device was originally activated.

deviceHash.description: A SHA256 hash of the unique hardware device ID of the user's device.

applicationId.description: The application ID being used for the device.

currentClientApiVersion.description: The Encap client API version that the user's device used for its last operation.

activatedClientApiVersion.description: The Encap client API version that the user's device was originally activated on.

activatedEncapRelease.description: The Encap server release version that the user's device was originally activated on.

pushAddress.description:
The push address for the user's device. 

 This address is used when sending a push to the device using Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) or Apple Push Notification Service (APNS).

operatingSystemType.description: The operating system type of the user's device.

activatedAuthenticationMethods.description:
A list of the activated authentication methods for the user's device. 

 See [authentication methods](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Authentication-methods) for possible values.

recoveries.description: A list that contains all of the recoveries for a user's device.

recoveryLock.description:
A setting for a user's device which indicates whether the account recovery feature is enabled or not.
  • When false, the account recovery feature is enabled and recovery operations can be performed.
  • When true, the account recovery feature is disabled and recovery operations cannot be performed.

lockReason.description:
A list that contains all reasons why the user's device has been locked. 

 See [Lock reason](/apis/mobileid/#section/Common-concepts/Lock-reason) for possible values.

accuracy.description: The location accuracy of the device used for the operation.

altitude.description: The location altitude of the device used for the operation.

latitude.description: The location latitude of the device used for the operation.

longitude.description: The location longitude of the device used for the operation.

sessionExpiryTime.description:
The timestamp when the recovery session expires.

Returned in pattern `yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss.SSSZ`.

activatedAuthenticationMethods.description: A list of the activated authentication methods.
